chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Joining Cab Calloway for ten weeks of theaters
summary: McRae reluctantly agreed to help Cab out, and travelled in cold Canadian weather.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: But now, knowing Cab -- When I went with Cab, Cab had ten weeks of theaters. "He can't get a tenor player."
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

When I went up there, he got ten weeks of theaters. And he was glad -- So when I got off -- I took the plane the next morning and went up to Toronto and everybody was wondering who this tenor player that come up here, because Chick had played Canada just vaguely. Just went through Toronto and Montreal then came on back, you know. Wasn't such a big thing, you know, up there. You know, we just went up there to do a few dance dates and we came on back out of there. And I don't remember too many -- what we ever did, because we wasn't up there that long. I think we did a couple of -- was real cold. I know it was real cold because I bought a coat when I was up there. And everybody say, 'Where you get that coat?' I say, 'In Canada.' A wrap-around. First time they wore those wrap around plaid coats. But it was real cold --
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
The tailend of October that you joined Cab Calloway.
Yeah. It was October. The weather was good. The weather wasn't that bad. The weather only got bad when we got to Buffalo when we played --
Up there we played these one nighters up there. I think it was two or three I played up there with him and came into Buffalo, or something like that.
We coming down -- yeah, we come into Buffalo and the weather was, whew! I stayed with him a good two years. And I liked the band.
It was a band that was well together, but the band didn't have the spirit like coming out of Chick's band. You know, it was so much happening over there, you know.
Not because I was the straw boss or something like that, but just nothing happened. So --
